findings.method: read_file of 22-data-operations-observability.mmd; grep Loki/Tempo in diagrams; compare to current-state-diagrams.md, current-state-inventory.md (retired 2026-07-23), ADR-010, Agents.md dashboard routing.

findings.expected: Every storage/PII node has an explicit labeled definition (Hashed PII, BronzeWriter, SilverWriter) matching GoldWriter style.

findings.impact: Security/audit view is incomplete: Bronze/Silver writers appear as opaque IDs. Not a wrong hashing algorithm, but operators cannot read the storage-audit path.

findings.remediation: Declare HASHED['Hashed PII'], BW['BronzeWriter'], SW['SilverWriter'] inside the appropriate subgraphs; re-render SVG.

findings.observation: PR source-vs-SVG drift gate and pre-commit lint globs cover architecture/foundation/class-diagrams/views only; providers, sequence, and state-machines can change without requiring sibling SVG updates.
findings.method: read_file docs.yml check-diagram-drift; read_file .pre-commit-config.yaml lint-diagrams files:; compare to test_source_diagrams_have_sibling_svg_artifacts (stem existence only).
findings.expected: Every tracked source family with sibling SVG policy is in check-diagram-drift and pre-commit files: globs.
findings.actual: Drift job globs: architecture/*.mmd, foundation/*.mmd, class-diagrams/*.mmd, views/*.mermaid. Pre-commit files: same plus views. Secondary: 28+5+5 sources. Architecture tests only assert matching stems, not git diff of SVG content.
findings.impact: Stale SVG for provider/sequence/state diagrams can merge. Nightly render does not fail git diff for those families.
findings.root_cause: Drift/pre-commit wired to original ADR-040 primary trees; secondary families added later (#8622) without glob update.
findings.remediation: Add :(glob)docs/02-architecture/diagrams/{providers/**,sequence,state-machines}/*.mmd to check-diagram-drift and matching pre-commit files: patterns. Update test_precommit_diagram_paths_cover_canonical_tree.

findings.observation: AST-derived 90-pkg-* class diagrams have a --check mode but it is not a python -m scripts.diagrams command and is not invoked from GitHub workflows; headers remain @date 2026-03-27 (STALE-002 warn band vs 90d).
findings.method: read_file generator --check; grep generate_package_family in .github/workflows and tests; grep COMMAND_SPECS in scripts/diagrams/__main__.py; grep %% @date in 90-pkg-*.mmd.

findings.root_cause: Generator exists as a manual tool; not wired into public CLI or CI.
findings.remediation: Add CLI command and a docs/architecture CI --check step. Refresh 90-pkg-* and sibling SVG from current AST.
